en: So you're the brat who's been meddling all over the islands. Come here. I'll deal with you myself.
These islands are Team Rocket's hunting ground now. Their Pokémon will fetch a fine price far away.
Hmph. You're no ordinary child. Team Rocket will be back, you know, with or without our boss.
Everyone, we're pulling out! Leave the Pokémon!
You followed me here? This gem is going to make me rich, and nobody is taking it away from me!
Fine, fine! Take your precious stone. I only wanted to study it before I sold it, anyway.
Leave me be. I have notes to write up.
Did you hear? The boss of Team Rocket has a son. A boy with red hair, they say, somewhere far to the west.
Pokémon are shut in a pen here. They look frightened.
The pen stands open. The Pokémon that were kept here have all gone home.
